current.text: He has a small hamstring issue. Yahoo lists him as questionable.
The hamstring issue does not look significant.
He is back at full health and is in Indiana's projected starting five with Haliburton, Nembhard, Siakam and Zubac.
Kelly Oubre Jr. joined Indiana and is projected as the sixth man. If Oubre starts, he would start over Nesmith.
With Haliburton back and less need to create his own shot, his FG% should bounce back. One expert expects about 30 minutes, 13 points and a couple of threes per game.
If his shooting returns to 48 to 50 percent, he could be a top 100 player.
His upside is low. He is good value as a late pick around 160 to 168, but not an upside pick near 110.
One expert would not draft him in 10 or 12 team leagues but is fine with him as a 10th player in 14 team leagues.
He should be worth more in category leagues than in points leagues this season. Points league rankings should have him 20 to 30 spots later.
Coach Rick Carlisle keeps regular-season minutes low, even for healthy players, and rests players on back-to-backs.
Indiana plays 3, 4 and 3 games in our fantasy playoff weeks, which is not ideal. The team has 15 back-to-backs.
Indiana is projected to win 46 to 48 games.

durable.text: He is a great three-point shooter.
He is not a self-creator. Without Haliburton his finishing at the rim fell from 67 to 39 percent, his two-point shooting from 59 to 46 percent and his FG% from 51 to 41 percent.
He commits many fouls for a wing.
The experts disagree on his defensive stats. One says he gets value from steals. Another says his defensive stats are poor for his minutes. Projections have him slightly below the pool in steals.
Assists are his weakest category for his position. He fits punt AST builds.

note: Yahoo ranks him 154 and ESPN 177, both at 0 USD. Experts see value around picks 160 to 168, so he sits just outside our 144 player draft. Treat him as a 1 USD end-of-draft pick for punt AST teams, or as a waiver watch. Check his hamstring early, and check whether his FG% climbs back toward 48 to 50 percent next to Haliburton and whether he keeps his starting job over Oubre. If both go his way, he has top 100 upside.
